name: Angelique Trois
original_name: アンジェリーク トロワ
source:
Third installment in the series. Angelique Collet now queen of a new cosmos, is drawn into a pocket cosmos, Arcadia, with the rest of the Angelique Special 2 cast. She develops the wilderness of Arcadia in order to free Elda, a strange being she finds there.

[From [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angelique_(Japanese_series)]Wikipedia[/url]]
translation:
系列第三部。已经成为新宇宙女王的安琪莉可·科蕾特，与《安琪莉可Special 2》的其他角色一同被吸入名为阿尔卡迪亚的袖珍宇宙。为了释放在那里发现的神秘存在厄尔达，她开始开拓阿尔卡迪亚的荒野。

[摘自[url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Angelique_(Japanese_series)]维基百科[/url]]
